settings.loyalty.title: Loyalty programme
settings.loyalty.intro: The loyalty programme: its period, reward budget, how stamps and points are earned, the decision on the Department of Industry and Trade notification and the staff phones that never earn. Each change applies from the next earn.
settings.loyalty.tabs.label: Loyalty programme sections
settings.loyalty.programme.title: Programme
settings.loyalty.demo: The demo shows a sample programme, read only. With live data, the owner and managers of every store edit the programme here.
settings.loyalty.readOnly.role: You can view the programme. Only the owner and managers of every store can change it.
settings.loyalty.readOnly.scope: You manage some stores, so you can view the programme. It applies to the whole chain, so only the owner or a manager of every store can change it.
settings.loyalty.empty: No programme yet. Create one to enter how stamps and points are earned and the notification decision.
settings.loyalty.group.decision: Department of Industry and Trade notification
settings.loyalty.name.label: Programme name
settings.loyalty.name.hint: 1 to 120 characters; customers see this name in the app.
settings.loyalty.budget.label: Reward budget
settings.loyalty.budget.hint: The expected total value of rewards for the whole programme; used for the notification threshold.
settings.loyalty.startsOn.label: Start date
settings.loyalty.endsOn.label: End date
settings.loyalty.endsOn.hint: Leave empty when the programme has no end date yet.
settings.loyalty.status.label: Status
settings.loyalty.status.hint: A draft never earns; Active earns from synced invoices; Paused and Ended stop earning.
settings.loyalty.hold.on: Launch on hold: the programme cannot become Active until you record the notification decision below.
settings.loyalty.hold.off: The notification decision is recorded; the programme can become Active.
settings.loyalty.hold.refused: The programme cannot become Active while the notification decision is pending. Record the decision first; nothing was saved.
settings.loyalty.param.stampsPerCard.hin: With this many stamps a customer redeems a card reward.
settings.loyalty.param.stampMinBillAmoun: An invoice of this amount or more earns one stamp; a smaller one earns points only.
settings.loyalty.param.welcomeStamps.hin: Fewer than a full card; staff phones get none.
settings.loyalty.param.stampValidityMont: A stamp expires this many months after its invoice.
settings.loyalty.param.pointUnitAmount.h: Each such amount of the invoice (after discounts) earns points.
settings.loyalty.param.pointsPerUnit.hin: Set 0 to turn points off and use stamps only.
settings.loyalty.param.pointsExpiryMonth: Points expire this many months after their invoice, oldest first.
settings.loyalty.param.earningInvoicesPe: Earning invoices per phone per day
Invoices beyond this count in one business day do not earn.
settings.loyalty.param.receiptClaimsPerP: How many receipts a member may claim in one business day.
settings.loyalty.param.checkinWindowBefo: Match invoices sold before a check-in
An invoice sold up to this many minutes before staff record the check-in code still matches.
settings.loyalty.param.checkinWindowAfte: Match invoices sold after a check-in
An invoice sold up to this many minutes after the check-in code is recorded still matches.
settings.loyalty.param.checkinCodeTtlSec: The code a customer shows to staff expires after this many seconds.
settings.loyalty.param.checkinPendingHou: A check-in still unmatched after this many hours is closed.
settings.loyalty.param.receiptClaimWindo: Customers may claim a receipt for this many hours after the purchase.
Used for the value of points issued and the points liability.
settings.loyalty.param.expectedBreakageR: Used for the points liability until six months of expiry data exist; 0 to 90%.
settings.loyalty.sources.label: Order sources that never earn
settings.loyalty.sources.hint: One order source per line (its code or name on the POS), such as delivery app orders. At most 50.
settings.loyalty.decision.intro: A promotion is notified to the Department of Industry and Trade at least 3 working days before launch, unless the total reward value stays under 100 million dong. Record your decision and its basis; the programme stays on hold until the decision is recorded.
settings.loyalty.decision.label: Decision
settings.loyalty.decision.pending.body: the programme is on hold and cannot run.
settings.loyalty.decision.notified.body: the notification was sent before launch; record the date it was sent.
settings.loyalty.decision.below_threshol: the total reward value is under 100 million dong, so no notification is due.
settings.loyalty.decision.not_required.b: another legal basis applies; the basis must be recorded.
settings.loyalty.decision.legalLink: See the legal texts in Settings → Legal
settings.loyalty.decidedOn.label: Decision date
settings.loyalty.decidedOn.hint: The date the notification was sent or the decision was made. Left empty, the save date is used.
settings.loyalty.basis.label: Basis
settings.loyalty.basis.hint: A short basis for the decision, at most {max} characters; required for Not required.
settings.loyalty.error.endBeforeStart: The end date is on or after the start date.
settings.loyalty.error.basisRequired: Record the legal basis for Not required.
settings.loyalty.error.welcomeBelowCard: Welcome stamps are fewer than a full card.
settings.loyalty.error.refused: The database did not accept this value; see the limits in the hint.
settings.loyalty.error.otherActive: Another programme is active. Pause or end it first.
settings.loyalty.phones.title: Staff phones
settings.loyalty.phones.intro: Invoices and receipt claims of these phones never earn. Numbers are always masked; only the owner and managers see the list.
settings.loyalty.phones.none: No phone on the list yet.
settings.loyalty.phones.phoneHint: For example 09xx xxx xxx or +84 9x xxx xxxx.
settings.loyalty.phones.label: Note
settings.loyalty.phones.labelHint: Optional, such as the role; no names.
settings.loyalty.phones.labelTooLong: A note holds at most 100 characters.
settings.loyalty.phones.duplicate: This phone is already on the list.
settings.loyalty.phones.invalid: This phone number cannot be read.
settings.loyalty.membersLink: See members, ledgers and the reconciliation queue
settings.loyalty.confirmation.title: How each store confirms loyalty
settings.loyalty.confirmation.intro: Each store chooses what confirms an earn or a reward: the POS invoice once it syncs, or staff recording the paper bill at the counter with the customer confirming it. Only an owner of the store can change it; managers and viewers only read.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.compare.po: Exact: points are added only once the real invoice has synced from the POS, and staff type no amount.
Customers wait for the next sync to see their points, and the store needs a POS with a working sync.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.compare.st: Instant and works with any POS, even without a sync: staff scan the customer's code and type the number and total of the paper bill.

There is no POS invoice to check against, so it relies on the customer typing the total again without seeing the staff's figure, plus caps and random audits. Every step is logged and there is a per-staff anomaly report.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.compare.no: While a store confirms at the counter, its POS invoices no longer earn; they only feed a background check if there are any.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.noStores: There is no store in your scope yet.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.mode.pos_s: Points and rewards are confirmed when the POS invoice syncs.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.mode.staff: Staff record the paper bill in the staff app; the customer types the total again to confirm it. No POS needed.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.switch.toS: Once saved, POS invoices no longer earn at this store; staff record bills in the staff app.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.switch.toP: Once saved, staff can no longer record bills; points are added only when the POS invoice syncs.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.knobsNote: The limits below apply only while the store confirms at the counter; you may set them before switching.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.group.adva: Undo window, random audits, the counter QR code and the background check. The defaults are safe; change them only when needed.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.level.hint: The evidence a bill needs before its points are confirmed. Level 2 stops staff inventing bills, since the customer must type the same total.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.level.0: 0 · Staff total alone (confirmed at once, riskiest)
settings.loyalty.confirmation.level.1: 1 · One reading of the bill (photo reader, coming)
settings.loyalty.confirmation.level.2: 2 · Customer's total agrees with the staff's (recommended)
settings.loyalty.confirmation.silence.hi: Applies to a bill without enough evidence once the wait for the customer ends.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.silence.re: Take the points back and tell a manager (recommended)
settings.loyalty.confirmation.silence.co: Confirm at the evidence it has
settings.loyalty.confirmation.selfClaim: Let customers scan a QR code at the counter
The staff app shows a short-lived QR code; the customer scans it and types the bill total, staff type nothing.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.shadowReco: Check against POS invoices in the background
If the store still syncs a POS, counter bills are compared with POS invoices in the background; a mismatch is only flagged and never blocks an earn.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.knob.maxBi: A bill above this does not earn when staff record it. Stops one huge invented bill.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.knob.billM: A bill above this always waits for a manager, even when the customer confirmed it. At most the largest bill.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.knob.billA: The customer's and the staff's totals agree when they differ by at most this (small change). Keep it small to make cheating hard.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.knob.billU: A bill without enough evidence waits this many hours for the customer, then the no-answer rule applies.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.knob.billS: Unverified bills per staff member a day
How many bills backed only by the staff member's word one person may record in a day; an alert fires at 70 %. Bounds the loss if one staff member invents bills.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.knob.staff: Total per staff member a day
The total of the bills one staff member may record in a business day.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.knob.store: How many bills the whole store may record in a day, auto-approved counter claims included.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.knob.staff: Rewards per staff member a day
How many rewards one staff member may confirm in a day; stops mass redemptions for friends.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.knob.rever: A manager may reverse an earn or void a reward this long after it was confirmed (about a shift); later it takes a manual adjustment.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.knob.billA: The share of confirmed bills put in the manager's queue for a second look; staff cannot know which ones.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.knob.count: Each counter QR code works for this many seconds; a short life stops a photo of it being used later.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.knob.autoA: A counter claim up to this total is confirmed at once without staff (0: never). An owner-accepted risk, bounded and logged.
How many counter claims the store may approve automatically in a day.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.knob.billP: How many days a bill photo is kept when photos are taken; after that only the reading stays.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.demo: The demo shows sample settings, read only: one store confirms at the counter, the other matches POS invoices. With live data, the owner changes the confirmation here.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.readOnly.o: You can only read this. Only an owner of the store changes the confirmation and its limits.
settings.loyalty.confirmation.readOnly.s: This store is outside your owner scope, so you can only read it.
